why: This asks for the Hales-Jewett number HJ(3,3), the minimal dimension guaranteeing X a win on a width-3 board; a 2026 preprint (arXiv 2607.18111, Conlon/Farnsworth/Robertson) reports a new lower bound HJ(3;3)>=14 via SAT solvers, and a related 2026 preprint (arXiv 2606.22155) also gives improved lower bounds for Hales-Jewett numbers via symmetric colorings.
